capture: Exact RTK stdout and completed write_stdin tool results retained from the existing executions. No test was rerun.
timing: testDurationSeconds is the test-suite time printed by RTK. Completion receipt wall_time_seconds is the poll call duration, not compilation or full command duration. Absolute command start/completion times were not retained and are not inferred.
unfilteredCargoOutput: Not retained; the archived stdout is the RTK output actually returned, not a reconstructed Cargo log.
